test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 30 Jun 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select a suitable figure from the answer figures which would replace the question mark (?).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85ff00a94cfb90508ed1b07132aa07a303a9060794133196b1e0b475559606ea.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: **One side and one inner image are increasing in every next step.

In the first image, there are 3 sides and 3 inner figures.

In the second image, there are 4 sides and 4 inner figures.

In the third image, there are 5 sides and 5 inner figures.

Thus, in the fourth image, there will be 6 sides and 6 inner figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ab40349ee2902f2616cb68a2000402db8e15ad1d7e3234b426f60b3e121cf8d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
